sql: SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country != 'Germany'
SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(customerNumber) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate >= '2004-01-01' AND paymentDate < '2004-07-01'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.reportsTo FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T2.employeeNumber WHERE T1.country = 'France'

SELECT T3.addressLine1, T3.addressLine2 FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T2.employeeNumber INNER JOIN offices AS T3 ON T2.officeCode = T3.officeCode WHERE T1.city = 'NYC' AND T2.jobTitle = 'Sales Rep'
SELECT SUM(T2.quantityOrdered), AVG(T2.priceEach) FROM products AS T1 INNER JOIN orderdetails AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode WHERE T1.productName = '18th Century Vintage Horse Carriage'
SELECT T1.amount FROM payments AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customerNumber = T2.customerNumber WHERE T2.customerName = 'Petit Auto' AND T1.paymentDate = '2004-08-09'
SELECT T1.addressLine1, T1.addressLine2 FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.customerNumber = T2.customerNumber WHERE T2.orderNumber = 10383
SELECT T2.email FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T2.employeeNumber WHERE T1.customerName = 'Dragon Souveniers, Ltd.'
SELECT (T1.MSRP - T2.priceEach) / T1.MSRP FROM products AS T1 INNER JOIN orderdetails AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode WHERE T1.productCode = 'S18_3482' AND T2.orderNumber = 10108
SELECT T1.customerName FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T2.employeeNumber WHERE T2.firstName = 'Steve' AND T2.lastName = 'Patterson'
SELECT T2.addressLine1, T2.addressLine2 FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode WHERE T1.jobTitle = 'President'

SELECT T3.productName FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.customerNumber = T2.customerNumber INNER JOIN orderdetails AS T4 ON T2.orderNumber = T4.orderNumber INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T4.productCode = T3.productCode WHERE T1.customerName = 'Cruz & Sons Co.' AND T2.orderDate = '2003-03-03'
SELECT T2.shippedDate FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.customerNumber = T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.customerName = 'Cruz & Sons Co.' AND T2.orderDate = '2003-03-03'

SELECT COUNT(T2.customerNumber) FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.orderNumber = T2.orderNumber WHERE T1.productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM products WHERE productName = '1957 Chevy Pickup')

SELECT T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customerNumber = T2.customerNumber INNER JOIN employees AS T3 ON T2.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T3.employeeNumber WHERE T1.status = 'Disputed'
SELECT T1.productName FROM products AS T1 INNER JOIN orderdetails AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode ORDER BY T2.priceEach DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT contactFirstName, contactLastName FROM customers WHERE salesRepEmployeeNumber = 1370 ORDER BY creditLimit DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.productName, SUM(T1.quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode INNER JOIN orders AS T3 ON T1.orderNumber = T3.orderNumber WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3.orderDate) = '2003' GROUP BY T2.productName ORDER BY SUM(T1.quantityOrdered) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.customerName FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.customerNumber = T2.customerNumber WHERE T2.status = 'Disputed'
